data.disable_automations: Disable the replaced wall switch automations

data_description.import_legacy: Covers keep their entity_id, area, voice aliases and labels: your automations, groups and dashboards keep working. Then remove the cover_rf_time_based section from configuration.yaml and restart.
data_description.disable_automations: They are only disabled, not deleted: you can re-enable them if needed.

user.title: New cover
user.description: A cover whose position is computed from its travel time.

data_description.name: Display name, e.g. “Office shutter”.
data_description.switch: The entity driving the motor (e.g. an RFXCOM switch): on = open, off = close.
data_description.inverted: Tick if the cover closes when the control is turned on.
data_description.time_up: Time for a full opening, closed to open. The calibration wizard can measure it for you.
data_description.time_down: Time for a full closing, open to closed.
data_description.area_id: Area of the device created for this cover.
data_description.wall_event: Optional: the switch's event entity (RFXCOM creates one event entity per switch).
data_description.wall_mode: “Relayed”: presses go through Home Assistant (press = open / close, or stop if already moving). “Paired with the motor”: the motor reacts by itself, Volets HOLM only tracks the position.

data.send_stop_at_ends: Send a stop at end of travel
data.recal_full: Full re-sync when already at end-stop

data_description.stop_mode: RF modules (AC, DI-O, Chacon…) stop when the same command is sent again.
data_description.stop_entity: Only if stopping uses a dedicated script, button or switch.
data_description.send_stop_at_ends: Sends the stop once the end-stop is reached (useful for modules that stay active).
data_description.endstop_extra: Seconds added when travelling to an end-stop (fully open or closed) to absorb drift.
data_description.recal_full: If the cover is already reported at the end-stop, a new command runs a full travel: handy when a previous radio command was missed.

reconfigure.title: What do you want to do?

calib.title: Calibration — 1/5
calib.description: The cover will first close completely. Stay near the cover (or watch it), then submit to start closing.

calib_closed.title: Calibration — 2/5
calib_closed.description: Wait until the cover is **fully closed**. Then submit: it starts opening and the timer starts.

calib_up.title: Calibration — 3/5: opening
calib_up.description: The cover is opening… Submit **as soon as it reaches the top**.

calib_top.title: Calibration — 4/5
calib_top.description: Opening measured: {up} s. Submit to start closing (the timer restarts).

calib_down.title: Calibration — 5/5: closing
calib_down.description: The cover is closing… Submit **as soon as it reaches the bottom**.

calib_result.title: Measured times
calib_result.description: Previous values: {old_up} s opening, {old_down} s closing. Adjust if needed, then save.

error.stop_entity_required: Pick the stop entity, or another stop method.

abort.not_loaded: The cover is not loaded: try again in a moment.

legacy_yaml.title: Old cover configuration still active
legacy_yaml.description: {platform} covers are still loaded from configuration.yaml ({entities}). Remove the `cover: - platform: {platform}` section (and the related scripts and input_text if no longer needed), then restart Home Assistant, otherwise these covers will appear twice.

set_known_position.name: Set known position
set_known_position.description: Corrects the known position without sending anything to the motor.

recalibrate.name: Re-sync
recalibrate.description: Sends the cover to the nearest end-stop with a full travel, to restart from a known position.

detect_legacy.name: Analyse existing setup
detect_legacy.description: Lists the Cover Time Based covers and wall switches Volets HOLM can import, without changing anything.
